messages:
melanie: Quick check — review week starts Monday. We still have ~7 managers out or partial LOA. Can we confirm safety-net plan? I sketched a small delegation + reviewer-swap flow below. TL;DR: manager-delegates -> reviewer-confirm -> People Ops approves.

jamal: SGTM. Can we get a CSV export for delegations to feed into handback? link?

melanie: Template below — paste into a CSV and upload to the review-swap sheet:
```
employee,employee_id,manager,delegate_email,delegate_name,effective_start,effective_end,scope,notes
Alice Zhang,10023,Marcus Li,tess@redwood.com,Tess O,2026-03-24,2026-04-01,full-review,returning from paternity
```

hr-bot: Reminder: Reviewer Swap Sheet updated by melanie — https://sheets.redwood/review-swap :white_check_mark:

sophie: Quick q — for reviewers already >30 reviews assigned, do we allow splitting a manager's batch across two reviewers? Last cycle we avoided splits unless necessary.

jamal: We can allow splits if manager confirms in comments and both reviewers acknowledge. Add `split` in the scope column and cc people-ops. I'll update the SOP.

tess: Confirming I'll cover for Eka (eng manager) Mon-Wed — added myself to the sheet. @melanie please mark Eka's handback as delegated.

melanie: Got it, thanks Tess. I'll run a quick audit tomorrow morning and nudge managers who haven't delegated. One edge-case: external contractors need Legal sign-off before we delegate. Added a note in the sheet.

kai: FYI: autopopulate validation script runs 06:00 UTC. It checks emails + overlap rules and will post failures to this thread. If it pukes, I'll ping infra.

melanie: Final ask: for partial LOA, set expiry = LOA end + 7 days to give buffer before reassigning. I'll drop a short how-to doc in #docs and DM managers who haven't set expiry. Thanks everyone :heart:
